description: 4th connection. 3rd connection (2026-09-28T22:33:08Z) compiled both F0805A and Q0805B cleanly (00 highest severity) for the first time. Two findings from that connection's run section, both fixed here, neither yet verified on real hardware: (1) F0805A's printed output was JU0300's own real printed output shifted exactly 1 column right on every line (byte-for-byte diff confirmed locally against work/verify/f0805a-run2.txt) - f0805as.rpgle's printDetail/l1Break/l2Break/grandTotal column positions are fixed and q0805bs.sqlrpgle's printLine positions are fixed pre-emptively the same way. Both files' ORIGINAL %subst positions had been set to literally match the OBSERVED start columns recorded in golden-master.md's own captured JU0300/ZA0500 text (e.g. JUNO's observed start column 6). That assumption - declaring %subst position N in a rewrite reproduces real print column N - is false: golden-master.md's own data (corrected after this finding to document it explicitly, which an earlier draft of this description incorrectly claimed it already did) shows the naive start column derived from each ORIGINAL program's own O-spec end column (end - length + 1) is consistently 1 LESS than that program's own real observed print column - and this SAME +1 shift turned out to apply to a %subst-based rewrite's own declared position too. Fix: declare every %subst start column in both rewrites as the O-SPEC-DERIVED value (one less than the observed column that had been copied directly), so each rewrite's real printed output reproduces the ORIGINAL's real observed columns correctly. The mechanism behind this shared +1 shift is NOT established. (2) RUNQ0805B failed at runtime: MCH1202 Decimal data error at statement 440 (`if avail < minqty;`), caused by CALL PGM(&LIB/Q0805B) PARM('*TEST' 5) passing a bare CL numeric literal (*DEC(15 5)) where Q0805B's dcl-pi declares packed(5:0) - the same class of parameter-type mismatch JU0900C itself was fixed for (05-13 ticket 1). Fixed by a new helper, verify/part08-05-f0805a/src/q0805bh.clp (Q0805BH), which DCLs &MINQTY as a real *DEC LEN(5 0) CL variable (VALUE(5), confirmed from ju0900c-ticket1.clp's own CHGVAR) before calling Q0805B, matching za0500h.clp's own established precedent. RUNQ0805B below now calls Q0805BH instead of Q0805B directly. Everything else in this manifest (JU0300/F0805A/ZA0500/JU0900C compile+run steps) is unchanged from the 3rd connection - see git history for the fuller original description.

steps.cmd:
DLTPGM PGM(&LIB/JU0300)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CRTRPGPGM PGM(&LIB/JU0300) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGSRC) SRCMBR(JU0300) REPLACE(*YES)
